claims.text: The rider's claim that this driver 'has six deviation flags' points to driver_profile.prior_deviation_flags, a LIFETIME counter. That field is context only under POL-GEN-01 and may never ground a finding; the trailing-90-day counter the policy actually names, driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d, is 0. The rider's stated reason for a full refund therefore fails on the record, and the case must be decided on this trip's own trace.

The deviation is established on this trip's own trace. The governing field is gps_trace.trace_distance_km = 23.22 km against the booked optimal of 18.4 km, an excess of 4.82 km and 26.20%. Both POL-RD-01 tests pass: the excess exceeds 20% of optimal and exceeds 0.8 km absolute. The trace is COMPLETE, 100.0% coverage, 182 fixes at a 10 s interval, no gaps and max_gap_sec 0.0, so POL-RD-07(a) to (c) are not engaged and no independent corroboration is required.

The driver's only explanation on file is the one-word counterparty_statement 'Traffic.' No traffic_advisory covers this trip window: EV-ADVIS-02833-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and its issue code is MISSING_ARTIFACT. Under POL-RD-13 the assertion is tested against the traffic_advisory and nothing else, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. The driver names no advisory evidence ID, so this is a gap in the bundle rather than a POL-RD-10(5) contradiction, and the deviation stands at the measured figure.

No rider-requested detour can excuse any of the excess. The chat log for this trip carries 0 messages, so there is no rider instruction, no chat_message.waypoint_hint and no road named; POL-RD-04(a) to (c) cannot be satisfied and the corroboration test cannot even be run. The trip_record likewise shows no amended pickup or dropoff (pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null, amended_optimal_distance_km null), so POL-RD-05 supplies no adjusted optimal, and vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply.

The refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02 on a METERED fare. recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 18.4 + 0.28 x 24.8) x 1.0 surge) + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP = 25.3440. Charged_total is 30.46, so the refund is 30.46 - 25.3440 = 5.1160, rounded up to SGD 5.15. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and is 16.80% of charged_total, far below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND, not the full refund the rider asked for.

No ERP or surcharge correction is due on top of the POL-RD-02 figure. The fare_breakdown carries 0 ERP gantry lines and 0.00 total, no airport surcharge (the trip neither originates nor ends at an airport), and no waiting-time fee, so there is no off-route pass-through to refund under POL-RD-09(2) and no phantom line under POL-RD-09(4). Adding anything here would double-count what the recomputed fare already comprehends.

The rider's own profile does not weaken the claim. rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 1 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, so the POL-RD-08 corroboration uplift (which needs 4 or more claims with 1 or fewer substantiated) is not triggered, and the excess here is 26.20%, below the 30% figure that clause names in any event. The rider's burden under POL-RD-08(a) and (b) is discharged by matching trip identifiers and pickup timestamps across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown.

The rider's demand for a FULL_REFUND is not supported and I do not press it. The excess is 26.20%, below the 50% / 8.0 km materiality gate in POL-RD-01, so this is not a MATERIAL deviation; POL-RD-06 is not triggered, and driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 with completed_trips_90d 260, so no repeat-deviation pattern is established and no POL-RD-06(b) uplift or POL-RD-06(c) referral is available. The rider's remedy is the POL-RD-02 partial refund of SGD 5.15.

claims.text: The rider's claim of a route deviation is established on this trip's own trace: the GPS trace measures 23.22 km against a booked optimal of 18.4 km, an excess of 4.82 km, which is 26.2% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 establishment tests pass — the excess exceeds 20% of optimal and exceeds 0.8 km absolute. The governing figure is gps_trace.trace_distance_km (23.22 km), not the rounded trip_record.actual_distance_km (23.2 km), as POL-RD-01 requires.

The excess does not reach the MATERIAL threshold: 4.82 km is below the 8.0 km absolute materiality gate and 26.2% is below the 50% materiality gate set by POL-RD-01. The deviation is therefore established but not material, and the POL-RD-06 repeat-deviation pattern check is not triggered by materiality.

The driver's only explanation on file is the one-word counterparty statement 'Traffic.' No traffic advisory covers this trip: EV-ADVIS-02833-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and its issue detail states no advisory covers the Jurong Point corridor in this window. Under POL-RD-13 the driver's traffic assertion is tested against the traffic_advisory and nothing else; with no advisory on file the POL-RD-03 comparison cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. The driver cites no advisory evidence ID, so this is a gap in the bundle rather than a POL-RD-10(5) contradiction.

The driver cannot invoke POL-RD-04 (rider-requested detour): the chat log for this trip is empty — 0 messages, no first or last message timestamp — so there is no rider instruction, no waypoint_hint, and no road named. The corroboration test cannot even be attempted, and the clause is unavailable on the record.

The driver cannot invoke POL-RD-05 (pickup or dropoff relocation): the trip record shows original_pickup, original_dropoff, pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at all null, and amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min both null. No amendment occurred, so there is no amended optimal to re-run POL-RD-01 against.

The driver cannot invoke POL-RD-12 (pooled trip): the trip record shows vehicle_type RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, and solo_optimal_distance_km is null. The matched-itinerary baseline does not apply and the booked optimal of 18.4 km governs.

The GPS trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: it carries 182 fixes at a 10-second sample interval with 100.0% coverage, zero gaps and a maximum gap of 0 seconds, so none of limbs (a) to (c) fires. The trace is clean and the deviation may be established on it alone.

The rider has discharged the POL-RD-08 initial burden: the trip identifier TRP-02833 matches across the trip record, GPS trace and fare breakdown, the pickup timestamp is consistent, and the excess of 4.82 km / 26.2% meets the POL-RD-01 threshold on an unimpaired trace. The burden shifts to the driver, who has pointed to no specific artifact and no specific clause — a bare assertion of 'Traffic' with no advisory ID does not discharge it.

The rider's own profile does not trigger the POL-RD-08 corroboration uplift: rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 1, below the threshold of 4, so no additional corroboration beyond the GPS trace is required. This factor is cited only for the test POL-RD-08 names it for.

The refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02. The fare model is METERED, so the clause applies. recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 18.4 + 0.28 x 24.8) x 1.0 surge) + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP + 0 fixed surcharges + 0 waiting time - 0 promo = (3.80 + 13.80 + 6.944) + 0.80 = 25.344. Refund = charged_total 30.46 - 25.344 = 5.116, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 = 5.15. This is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and well below the 90% full-refund share (5.15 / 30.46 = 16.8%), so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND.

No ERP or surcharge correction is due under POL-RD-09: the fare breakdown carries zero ERP gantries and zero tolls, no airport surcharge (the trip neither originates nor ends at an airport), and no phantom charge line. There is no billing-integrity defect to refund separately, and the off-route ERP pass-through is nil.

The rider's claim text asserts 'six deviation flags' and demands a full refund. That figure is driver_profile.prior_deviation_flags, a LIFETIME counter, which POL-GEN-01 and POL-RD-06 expressly forbid substituting for the trailing-90-day figure. The citable field, driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d, is 0, and 0 / 260 completed trips is 0.0, far below the 0.05 ratio gate. No repeat-deviation pattern is established, so no POL-RD-06(b) full-refund uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral is available on this record. The rider's full-refund demand is not supported.

The driver's profile carries no_show_terminations_30d of 1 and completed_trips_30d of 108, but those fields are citable only for the POL-NS-07 no-show test, which is not this category. They are context only and may not ground any finding here.

No POL-RD-10 escalation trigger fires: the trip identifiers match across all three artifacts, the trace is unimpaired, no timestamps run backwards or disagree by more than 10 minutes, no exculpatory clause is invoked against a cited artifact that is missing or lacks its required field, the refund of 5.15 is far below SGD 150.00 and below charged_total, and no charge line lacks a counterpart. The case can be decided on the record.

The driver's assertion of traffic is a bare assertion that cites no evidence ID. Under POL-RD-08 an assertion from either side that cites no evidence ID carries no weight and is discarded. The driver has pointed to no specific artifact and no specific clause, so the burden the rider shifted is not discharged and the measured excess stands at 4.82 km.

ruling.explanation:
Rider — your claim succeeds in part. Driver — the measured excess stands, and your traffic explanation could not be tested because no traffic advisory is on file.

THE DEVIATION. The governing measurement is the GPS trace distance, 23.22 km (gps_trace.trace_distance_km), against the booked optimal route of 18.4 km (trip_record.optimal_distance_km). POL-RD-01 requires the trace figure over the rounded trip-record copy (23.2 km). Excess = 4.82 km, which is 26.2% of optimal. Both establishment tests pass (over 20% of optimal and over 0.8 km absolute), so a route deviation is ESTABLISHED. It is not a MATERIAL deviation — 4.82 km is under the 8.0 km gate and 26.2% is under the 50% gate — so the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is not triggered by materiality, and the evidence is not finely balanced. In any event driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 across 260 completed trips (ratio 0.0, against a 0.05 gate), so no repeat-deviation pattern is established: no POL-RD-06(b) uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral arises. The trace is also clean for policy purposes under POL-RD-07 — 182 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, zero gaps, maximum gap 0 s — so limbs (a) to (c) do not fire and no independent corroboration is needed. Rider, your 'six deviation flags' figure is driver_profile.prior_deviation_flags, a lifetime counter that POL-GEN-01 makes context only and POL-RD-06 expressly forbids substituting for the trailing-90-day counter; it cannot ground a full refund.

NO EXCUSE APPLIES. The chat log carries 0 messages, so POL-RD-04 cannot run (no rider instruction, no waypoint_hint, no road named). The trip record shows no amended pickup or dropoff and a null amended_optimal_distance_km, so POL-RD-05 supplies no adjusted optimal, and vehicle_type is RYDE_X, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. The driver's counterparty statement, 'Traffic.', names no artifact and no clause; the only advisory identifier in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-02833-01, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. Under POL-RD-13 the assertion is tested against the traffic_advisory and nothing else, so POL-RD-03 is unavailable and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Because the driver cited no advisory ID, this is a gap in the bundle, not a POL-RD-10(5) contradiction. The two driver-side claims to this effect were discarded at the citation check for citing the impaired advisory without naming its issue code; the rider-side claim that disclosed it survives and is accepted.

THE MONEY, under POL-RD-02 on this METERED fare, with the surge multiplier of 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier:
- charged_total: SGD 30.46
- recomputed_fare: ((3.80 + 0.75 x 18.4 + 0.28 x 24.8) x 1.0) + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP + 0 surcharge + 0 waiting time - 0 promo = SGD 25.3440
- refund: 30.46 - 25.3440 = SGD 5.1160, rounded UP to the nearest SGD 0.05 = SGD 5.15.
